planets.name: HD 73344 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 73344 with a 15.6-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: HD 73344 b was found in 2024 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 73344. Its orbit and size follow Sulis et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
